purpose: Sole cross-module type authority and sole IDB-key authority for the event-sourced-receive-engine epic. Defines RawProtocolFact, AcceptedDomainEvent (forward declaration — see judgment_calls), EngineCheckpoint, EngineOutputEvent, EngineLifecycleState/EngineHealth/EngineState, IngestSource/IngestSignal, and PersistenceAdapter, plus the four new IDB key-prefix constants and key-builder functions. Pure type module: the only runtime exports are the key constants/builders.

public_api.name: NostrEvent
public_api.signature: interface { id, pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content, sig }
public_api.description: Minimal locally-defined structural NIP-01 relay-event shape; not imported from any external SDK.

public_api.name: RawProtocolFact
public_api.signature: interface { id, seq, groupId, nostrEventId, nostrEvent, receivedAt, receiptSource, epochAtReceipt }
public_api.description: Durable content-addressed record of one relay delivery, pre-decryption.

public_api.name: AcceptedDomainEvent
public_api.signature: interface { id, factId, sourceKind, groupId, acceptedAt, epoch, payload: TaskEvent }
public_api.description: FORWARD DECLARATION — canonical (possibly generic) definition to be owned by src/domain/domain-events.ts in S2; see judgment_calls.

public_api.name: EngineLifecycleState
public_api.description: fsm.md lifecycle phase names; excludes degraded (health-only, per I-FSM-1).

public_api.name: EngineState
public_api.description: The engine's full state pair, fsm.md "State = { lifecycle, health }".

public_api.name: EngineCheckpoint
public_api.signature: interface { groupId, savedAt, engineState, lastEpoch, lastIngestedSeq, lastAcceptedDomainEventId, deferredNostrEventIds }

public_api.name: DeferredReason
public_api.description: Shared parked-disposition vocabulary; excludes parse_error (terminal, Implementation Constraint 13).

public_api.name: EngineOutputEvent
public_api.signature: discriminated union, 10 variants (envelope_received | envelope_deferred | domain_event_accepted | domain_event_rejected | projection_invalidated | group_epoch_advanced | group_ratchet_advanced | engine_state_changed | deferred_retry_started | recovered)
public_api.description: Every event the engine emits to react-engine-hooks.ts.

public_api.name: IngestSignal
public_api.signature: discriminated union, 5 variants (message | deferred | skipped | malformed | epoch_advanced)
public_api.description: Marmot-free signal the adapter emits and the engine consumes.

public_api.name: IngestSource
public_api.signature: interface { catchUp(): AsyncIterable<IngestSignal>; openLive(onSignal): Unsubscribe; close(): void }
public_api.description: Control interface the engine calls on the adapter; engine drives, never touches marmot directly.

public_api.name: PersistenceAdapter
public_api.signature: interface { appendFact, loadFacts, appendAcceptedEvent, loadAcceptedEvents, saveCheckpoint, loadCheckpoint, saveDeferredIds, loadDeferredIds }

owned_data: Type definitions only (per architecture.md Module Map row for engine-types)

The four new epic IDB key literals (notestr:raw-facts:, notestr:accepted-events:, notestr:engine-checkpoints:, notestr:deferred-ids:) — Boundary Rule 8/9 ownership, enforced by engine-boundary.structural.test.ts AC-BOUND-3
dependencies_allowed: src/store/task-events.ts (import type { TaskEvent } — type-only, sanctioned explicitly by this story's task text: 'Types may reference the app's TaskEvent wire type'; see judgment_calls for why this is treated as a documented exception to architecture.md's strict engine/* -> domain/* edge table rather than a boundary violation)
dependencies_forbidden: applesauce-core or any other external NostrEvent SDK type (a local structural NostrEvent is defined instead — see judgment_calls)

judgment_calls.decision: AcceptedDomainEvent is defined as a COMPLETE, non-generic interface in engine-types.ts (field-for-field match to architecture.md's Seam Contracts table), explicitly documented in its JSDoc as a forward declaration. architecture.md's Module Map assigns the canonical (possibly generic, dual-idempotency-key) definition to src/domain/domain-events.ts, which is out of S1's scope to create. Because src/domain/* -> nothing and src/engine/* -> src/domain/* is the only legal edge direction, engine-types.ts cannot import a not-yet-existing domain module. S2 should import + re-export this shape from src/domain/domain-events.ts rather than redefine it independently; flagged in the interface's own doc comment so S2 doesn't miss it.

Rather than importing NostrEvent from applesauce-core/helpers/event (the app's current source per exploration.json), engine-types.ts declares its own minimal structural NIP-01 NostrEvent interface. Rationale: architecture.md's 'Allowed dependency edges' table grants src/engine/* exactly one edge (src/domain/*); no external npm package is a declared allowed edge. A type-only import from applesauce-core would have zero runtime cost but would still be an undeclared coupling in the epic's foundational type-authority module. Structural typing keeps any real SDK's NostrEvent value assignment-compatible without a cast.

OutboxEntry (architecture.md Seam Contracts) is NOT defined in engine-types.ts. It is not in this story's explicit type-authority enumeration, has zero src/engine/ producer or consumer (entirely internal to src/integration/), has no IDB key in Rule 9's four-key table, and is explicitly marked 'Phase 6 pre-condition, TBD' in architecture.md. Defining it now risks drift before its Phase 6 shape is settled.

engine-boundary.structural.test.ts builds its IDB-key marker strings via concatenation ("notestr:" + "raw-facts:") and writes disallowed-import fixtures to temp scratch files (never as contiguous literal text in its own source), per the story's prior-learning note about self-referential structural-scan tests. Verified empirically: grep for each of the four IDB key literals over the test file's own source returns zero contiguous matches; engine-types.ts contains exactly one occurrence of each.
